trap.label: were com todos
trap.wrong: Were I braver, I will ask.
trap.right: Were I braver, I would ask.
trap.why: O português diz “se eu fosse mais corajoso, perguntaria”; o brasileiro troca por will. Em inglês, hipótese irreal: would + base.

mcq.q: ___ it not for you, I would fail.

opts: Was she here, she will help.
